summary: This CPU OpenMP build performs a host-to-local aligned copy/placement phase before timing, then the timed outer host loop calls GOMP_parallel once for each requested repetition. The outlined spmvCpu worker 0x3940 derives per-thread row boundaries from lower_bound cuts, then processes each row interval and every nonzero with multiply-add/store; all row partitions concatenate from row 0 through dim. The local CSR copy covers contiguous nonzeros [0,nItems), with final delimiter nItems. No omission is evident despite the unusual placement setup.

source_evidence.claim: Row partition boundaries are monotone lower_bound splits with endpoints 0/dim; source CSR is built to nItems; partition-wise local copy covers rows and corresponding contiguous nnz intervals, then timed loop repeats spmvCpu and copies output only after timing.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clock region has counted GOMP_parallel call at 0x1da6 and backedge 0x1dae against saved requested count. Worker 0x3940 derives row cuts using binary-search branches; per-thread row loop at 0x3a4b..0x3aab follows CSR delimiters, nonzero loop at 0x3a80..0x3a9c loads column/value/vector and accumulates, then stores at 0x3a9e. Empty-row path stores zero. Function includes all branches through the next symbol boundary.
